question: What was said in holy previous scripture?
premises: It was said in holy previous scripture.
By supreme lord, that is this.
Impurity is cause of world sprout.
inference: Holy previous scripture says supreme lord identifies impurity as ignorance and cause of world sprout.
uncertainties: malamajñānamicchanti may be read as 'they call impurity ignorance'.
plain_english: It was said in holy previous scripture, and by supreme lord that is this: they desire impurity as ignorance, cause of world sprout.
